name: wavegrain
description: Hosted MCP server for Wavegrain: curated TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels for your brand on autopilot. Agents read your brand, make slideshows in its voice with your photos, edit slides, schedule them and export, within a credit limit you set.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Sign in with your Wavegrain account through OAuth when the client connects.

examples.title: Make a carousel
examples.description: Create a slideshow from a topic in the brand's voice
examples.prompt: Make a 6-slide TikTok slideshow about morning routines for my brand.

examples.title: Edit a slide
examples.description: Change the text of one slide
examples.prompt: Change the hook on slide 1 of my latest slideshow to something shorter.

examples.title: Schedule a post
examples.description: Plan a slideshow on the content calendar
examples.prompt: Schedule my latest slideshow for Friday at 6 pm.
